description: Source code for a launcher class that manages remote execution of tests on RDK devices via pexpect, including process control, SSH interactions, and test orchestration.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class for launching and managing tests on RDK devices via SSH and pexpect, including process control, retries, and cleanup.

methods.name: _InitPexpectCommands
methods.description: Initializes commands for rsync, ssh, and test setup.

methods.name: _ShutdownBackoff
methods.description: Performs backoff and checks if shutdown is initiated.

methods.name: _PexpectSpawnAndConnect
methods.description: Spawns a pexpect process and connects to the device, handling login prompts.

methods.name: _PexpectSendLine
methods.description: Sends a command line to the pexpect process.

methods.name: _PexpectReadLines
methods.description: Reads lines from the pexpect process, detecting test completion.

methods.name: _Sleep
methods.description: Sends a sleep command to the device.

methods.name: _CleanupPexpectProcess
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the pexpect process.

methods.name: _WaitForPrompt
methods.description: Waits until the device prompt appears.

methods.name: _KillExistingCobaltProcesses
methods.description: Kills leftover Cobalt processes on the device.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method to execute the test sequence on the device.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Stops the launcher and aborts the test run.

methods.name: GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Returns the path for test output files.
